observations: Orange plastic gas cylinder with a metal valve assembly.
The cylinder is wrapped in a black hexagonal mesh protective sleeve.
A regulator is attached to the valve assembly.
The cylinder is shown from the side and from the top.
No brand name, model number, or weight stamp is visible on the body or valve in the photos.
The valve has a white sticker with text, but the text is too blurry to read.
The cylinder appears to be in good cosmetic condition.

claims.evidence: The weight stamp on the cylinder is not visible in the photos.
A regulator is attached to the valve in photo 1.

claims.claim: Recently tested and certified, no leak, the valve is new.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The cylinder may be expired or past its re-test date.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturing or expiry date stamp on the cylinder body.

risks.risk: The valve may be leaking or faulty.
risks.proof: A video showing a soap bubble test on the valve while under pressure.

risks.risk: The cylinder may be a lower capacity (e.g., 10kg) rather than 12.5kg.
risks.proof: A photo of the weight stamp on the cylinder body.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the weight stamp on the cylinder body showing the capacity in kg.
Photo of the expiry or manufacturing date stamp on the cylinder body.
Photo of the valve sticker to read the brand and model.
Video of a leak test on the valve.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
